Hi! Regarding SLOTPLAN-113: The design review notes state that when several starts are possible, pick the one closest to noon (minute 720). If two candidates are equally far from noon, take the earlier one. With an empty calendar, the break should therefore be (720, 750), not (690, 720). So test_several_options has the correct expectation.
